answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 32154 Country: India Title: Dreaming of Staircase Question: I recently dreamt i was going up a wooden stairs and i reached the final storey of the building which was the 29 storey(I saw the number). When i reached up, i could feel that the last step cracked. So i tried to come down but i made 1 step or 2 steps down and sat down since i could not go any further down ..i felt dizzy.. Can you please explain to me what could it mean. Answer ID: 32154 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1033/651/H=1432) The meaning of your dream is that your emotions are ready to go high but you lag far behind in following sunnah. Hence, you should pay special attention towards it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
